text: Question: The nurse in the community clinic is caring for a 70-year-old client who has been wearing new bilateral hearing aids for 2 weeks. Which of the following should the nurse include in the client’s care plan?
A. Check the client’s dexterity with hearing aid use.
B. Communicate with the client above the client’s eye level.
C. Speak with the client using loud, high-pitched tones.
D. Remind the client to take off the glasses while wearing hearing aids.
Correct answer: A. Check the client’s dexterity with hearing aid use.
notes: Correct: A new hearing-aid user needs the nurse to check that the client can handle and adjust the devices (dexterity) and has realistic expectations.
• Speak at eye level, face to face, not above it.
• Use a normal, lower-pitched tone; loud, high-pitched speech is harder to understand and can be distorted.
• Glasses can be worn with hearing aids, and the client does not need to remove them.
(Answer key not on the slide; worked out with NCLEX reasoning, so check it against your class notes.)
